backtest_protocol.execution_model: Annual InventoryNet is read as a raw SEC Companyfacts balance-sheet INSTANT fact (no FY duration) and matched to the trailing FY revenue ending the same fiscal-year date; both are known only by filed date (<= signal date). The current inventory/revenue ratio is compared with the prior annual period. Price confirmation uses only signal-date OHLCV. Paper entry is the next available open with existing entry slippage; exit is the close 10 trading days after the signal with target-side sell slippage and ROUND_TRIP_COST_PCT.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

raw SEC companyfacts annual revenue facts

2_history_check.exp-20260528-019: Rejected working-capital discipline (STABLE receivables/revenue and inventory/revenue as an FGRS support scalar). This run is a standalone candidate-pool source testing DIRECTIONAL inventory leanness, not ratio stability.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-031: Rejected operating-efficiency (asset turnover = revenue/assets). This run tests inventory leanness specifically, a demand-side balance-sheet field, not total asset turnover.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-002: Rejected low asset-growth quality. This run tests inventory contraction relative to sales, not broad balance-sheet growth.
2_history_check.exp-20260615-016: Rejected operating leverage acceleration. This run tests an input inventory-efficiency field rather than an operating-income outcome.
2_history_check.exp-20260616-014: Accepted SBC burden improvement used the same scout-then-adapter structure on a duration-based ratio field; this run uses a distinct INSTANT balance-sheet inventory field.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md canonical three windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least two EV-improved windows, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted compression/distribution candidate-pool comparators must be beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Inventory contraction relative to sales (Thomas-Zhang inventory anomaly) is a distinct demand-side balance-sheet quality field not loaded by the accepted fundamental_growth_rs CompanyfactsFundamentalIndex and distinct from working-capital stability, broad asset growth, and asset-turnover efficiency. Risk is high because raw Companyfacts quality fields have been saturated, the inventory universe is concentrated in hardware/industrial names, and price confirmation often relabels momentum, so the accepted compression/distribution comparators or drawdown/window guards may not be beaten.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing raw SEC annual InventoryNet instant fact, missing matching FY revenue, missing prior comparison period, stale facts, missing CIK mapping, missing OHLCV, missing next open, or missing 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production adapter changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.order_semantics: observe-only next-session-open paper entry; no broker order
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper and activation gate pass

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same raw SEC InventoryNet instant mapping, filed-date PIT inventory/revenue leanness gate, liquid SPY-relative confirmation, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production.
